title: fkcompute: an efficient $F_K$ invariant calculator
summary: We introduce fkcompute, an open-source package for computing the Gukov--Manolescu invariant of links from a braid presentation. fkcompute implements Park's inverted state sum through a three-phase pipeline. First, a search is performed for a suitable braid presentation and for an additional inversion data on the braid. Then, the state space of the inverted sum is encoded as a polytope, bounded by the associated linear constraint system.
